description: This file defines a PHP class 'Binomial' which provides statistical distribution functions related to binomial distributions, including probability mass/density functions, cumulative distribution functions, and inverse calculations, specifically for use within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation library.

classes.name: Binomial
classes.description: Provides functions for binomial distribution calculations such as probability, cumulative distribution, range probabilities, negative binomial, and inverse binomial calculations.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the binomial distribution probability or cumulative probability for given number of successes, trials, and probability of success.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Calculates the probability of a range of successes in binomial trials.

methods.name: negative
methods.description: Calculates the negative binomial distribution for failures before a number of successes.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Finds the smallest number of successes for which the cumulative binomial distribution meets or exceeds a given criterion (alpha).
